patches.author: Nihal Kumar Gupta <nihal.gupta@oss.qualcomm.com>
patches.subject: v7.3 context rebase of DTS v2 patches 1-3 (CAMSS, CSIPHY, CCI, MCLK)
patches.review_status: Konrad Dybcio Acked-by on patch 1. Christian Cortner Tested-by for patches 1-3 on UX3607OA with an ov02c10 node he described as CRD wiring and did not post. Konrad asked not to add A16 nodes to this series. Posted patch 1 does not apply safely: its CAMSS hunk context is two lines and git apply inserted the node after usb_mp. Posted patch 2 fails because sdc2_default_state is absent from v7.3. Added properties are copied from the lore diffs. Opp tables stay immediately before soc@0. CAMSS sits between evacc and dispcc. CCI and MCLK pinctrl sit inside &tlmm after qup_uart22_default. drive-strength stays 2.
patches.apply: v7.3 context rebase of patches 1-3; patches 4 and 5 are not applied
patches.hardware_status: Cortner Tested-by for the SoC nodes plus an unpublished A16 ov02c10 node. Jesse Casco measured MCLK4 at 2 mA banding; the 6 mA change is the optional patch, not this file.

patches.author: FixItFoundry zenbook-a16-linux, patch 0108; not upstream
patches.subject: A16 OV02C10 and HM1092 nodes, PM8010 regulators, reset pinctrl
patches.review_status: Not upstream. The posted file is not a git patch and does not apply on v7.3. Nodes were inserted at v7.3 anchors: PM8010 on &i2c5 before ptn3222_1, reset pinctrl before the existing LED pinctrl nodes, sensor nodes appended once. No address, GPIO, voltage, clock, or lane was edited. 0108 says PM8010 input rails remain firmware-managed until their supply mapping is verified. Both sensors' leds property points at the white privacy LED on TLMM 111, which is not an IR illuminator. build.sh skips this patch when APPLY_A16_BOARD=0.
patches.apply: v7.3 context placement of 0108; skipped when APPLY_A16_BOARD=0
patches.hardware_status: RGB bus cci1_i2c1, address 0x36, CSIPHY4 and 2 lanes match Cortner's public report. Reset TLMM 239, the 2.8 V and 1.8 V numbers, HM1092 on cci0_i2c0 at 0x24, reset TLMM 109, and LDO3 are unverified on the A16. IR illuminator is absent on purpose.

optional.author: local override from Jesse Casco's measurement; he did not post a patch
optional.subject: A16-only cam_mclk4 drive-strength 6
optional.review_status: Off by default (APPLY_MCLK4_6MA=1). Jesse Casco, 10 Nov 2026, on one UX3607OA: with drive-strength 2, OV02C10 on MCLK4 at 19.2 MHz shows horizontal banding and about a 9% longer frame period while the internal DMIC clock (LPASS LPI GPIO6, 2.4 MHz) runs. The bands are in the RAW10 frames and the sensor test pattern is clean. 6 mA on this pin fixed it, A/B/A across three boots. The override is on the A16 board file so other Glymur boards keep the posted 2 mA. It is not applied to glymur.dtsi.
optional.apply: optional, off by default; requires the A16 board patch
optional.hardware_status: Measured on one A16. Not upstream.
